parts.t: The Cambie neighbourhood is the jewel of Vancouver's West Side — a community of stately homes, excellent schools, and the beautiful tree-lined Cambie Street Corridor. With easy SkyTrain access along the Canada Line and proximity to Queen Elizabeth Park, it combines prestige with practicality.
